notes: Choropleth renders correctly with 6 quantile classes in YlOrRd on Positron light basemap; thin white outlines (getLineColor [255,255,255,180], 0.5px) and tooltip showing valuePerSqm and growth via getTooltip are all present.
Legend labels are broken by over-aggressive rounding: '$2k – $4k' followed by '$4k – $4k' then '$4k – $5k' (formatVal rounds to nearest thousand), so two classes are indistinguishable to the reader.

Uses dated deck.gl 8.9.35 with the v8 standalone `new deck.DeckGL({mapStyle})` pattern rather than v9 MapboxOverlay/addControl; the bundle also tries to fetch mapbox-gl.css (blocked by ORB, non-fatal).
